spec.name: sprint33_taker_imbalance_meanrev_liquid_crypto
spec.hypothesis: Extreme short-window taker buy/sell volume imbalance in liquid crypto (BTC, ETH) predicts short-horizon mean reversion; prior mean-rev failure (sprint31) was confounded by tail-liquidity execution cost, not signal invalidity.
spec.power_argument: Target n>=300 trades: cap 8 entries/symbol/day x 2 symbols x ~20 remaining sprint days = up to 320 trades. Min detectable edge set at 15bps net (must clear assumed T1 round-trip cost ~5-8bps on liquid BTCUSD/ETHUSD with margin) at t-test power 0.8, alpha 0.05.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
